razor_felix: Previous note said bathroom_shelf_ba1, but Day 10 07:05 feedback confirmed medicine_cabinet_ba1. The shelf is incorrect. Always check medicine_cabinet_ba1 for grooming items.

water_bottle_felix: Day 10 20:46 feedback confirmed kitchen_table_k1, contradicting my guess of dish_rack_k1. The previous note to check kitchen_table_k1 was correct. Continue checking kitchen_table_k1 for active drinkware.

glass_felix: Inconsistent location. Day 10 21:14 feedback showed cupboard_k1, but Day 10 22:15 feedback showed nightstand_b1. It does not stay in the kitchen cupboard late at night. Check nightstand_b1 for evening/late-night locations, as it moves with the resident to the bedroom.

tablet_felix: Day 10 21:35 feedback showed nightstand_b1, not bed_b1. The previous note suggested bed_b1 for evenings, but the nightstand is the correct spot. Check nightstand_b1 for the tablet in the evening.

charger_felix: Day 10 22:15 feedback showed nightstand_b1, not desk_b1. The previous note about entry_floor_e1 is outdated for evening hours. Check nightstand_b1 for charging accessories when the resident is in the bedroom at night.

mug_felix: No new errors today. Previous note to check cupboard_k1 for stored drinkware remains relevant, especially late at night, though glass_felix suggests items may move to the bedroom.

book_felix: No new errors today. Previous note to check bed_b1 for reading materials remains relevant.
